cases.question: 请把2024年GDP超过1000亿元的地区筛出来，按GDP从高到低列出地区名、GDP和公报报告的同比增速。
cases.developer_diagnosis_note: 原严格结果已匹配；本复核没有重新作答或判定语义。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.region_name,g.value,y.value FROM public_observations g JOIN public_regions r ON r.region_id=g.region_id JOIN public_observations y ON y.region_id=g.region_id AND y.year=g.year AND y.metric_id='gdp_growth' WHERE g.year=2024 AND g.metric_id='gdp' AND g.value>1000 ORDER BY g.value DESC,r.region_id;
cases.actual_sql: SELECT "r"."region_name" AS "地区名", MAX(CASE WHEN "o"."metric_id" = 'gdp' THEN "o"."value" END) AS "GDP亿元", MAX(CASE WHEN "o"."metric_id" = 'gdp_growth' THEN "o"."value" END) AS "同比增速百分比" FROM "main"."public_observations" AS "o" JOIN "main"."public_regions" AS "r" ON "r"."region_id" = "o"."region_id" WHERE "o"."year" = 2024 AND "o"."metric_id" IN ('gdp', 'gdp_growth') GROUP BY "o"."region_id", "r"."region_name" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "o"."metric_id" = 'gdp' THEN "o"."value" END) > 1000 ORDER BY "gdp亿元" DESC LIMIT 201
